skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply theoretical knowledge to solve practical problems in a business environment.
Analyze and evaluate the effectiveness of solutions, identify challenges, and propose improvements.
Build professional relationships with industry experts and expand career opportunities.
Install and configure basic software and hardware systems based on business requirements.
Use IT tools and software to perform specific tasks and install business software.
Adjust system settings based on specific requirements and evaluate business products.
Work effectively in teams to complete assigned tasks and projects.
Participate in group discussions, present personal opinions, and defend ideas.
